item.title: “He’s very interested in helping Jharkhand cricket grow”- Shahbaz Nadeem reveals MS Dhoni's role in team's SMAT success
item.description: Shahbaz Nadeem, ex-India player and current Jharkhand State Cricket Association’s (JSCA) joint secretary, has stated that legendary MS Dhoni is heavily consulted when it comes to the benefit of Jharkhand cricket. item.title: “There is a huge divide”- R Ashwin after Vaibhav Sooryavanshi and Bihar maul Arunachal Pradesh; praises Ishan Kishan’s resilience
item.description: Bihar broke the record for the highest team total in List-A 50-over games, as they slammed 574/6 in 50 overs against Arunachal Pradesh on December 24 in the ongoing Vijay Hazare Trophy 2025 tournament. item.title: Shreyas Iyer resumes batting for the first time since injury; set to visit BCCI CoE for further assessment- Report
item.description: Shreyas Iyer, India's ODI vice-captain, batted for the first time since being injured on December 24 in Mumbai, and the right-hander is currently on his way to the BCCI Centre of Excellence (CoE) in Bengaluru. item.description: Australia’s stand-in skipper Steve Smith has expressed his sympathy for the Ben Stokes-led England as the touring team faced severe backlash after losing the Ashes series. item.title: “Even Kevin Pietersen didn’t hit me like that,” Harbhajan Singh recalls spotting Ishan Kishan’s special talent
item.description: When the BCCI senior men’s selection committee announced India’s squad for the T20 World Cup 2026 last week, there was a notable inclusion in it.
